meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能通过 CDP 操控本机 Chrome：复用已有登录态、打开网址、执行网页脚本、提取页面中的文本或 token，并对网页做点击、输入等操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“浏览器操作”“CDP”“复用登录态”等词，或要求用 Chrome 做自动化、提取登录信息时触发。

say.text: 用Chrome打开example.com并读出首页文字
say.note: 经CDP打开页面后提取网页文本。
执行JS读取本地存储或Cookie里的令牌。

say.text: 通过CDP点击页面登录按钮并输入用户名
say.note: 先获取页面元素引用，再执行点击和输入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a local Chrome via CDP: reuse existing logins, open URLs, execute page JavaScript, extract text or auth tokens, and interact with pages by clicking and typing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “browser automation”, “CDP”, “复用登录态”, or ask to control Chrome for automation/reusing a login and extracting auth info.

say_en.text: Open example.com in Chrome and read the homepage text.
say_en.note: Opens the page via CDP and extracts its text.

say_en.text: Extract the token from the current Chrome login session.
say_en.note: Runs JS to read the token from local storage or cookie.

say_en.text: Click the login button on the page via CDP and type the username.
say_en.note: Snapshots the target element, then clicks and types.
